info.name: Rosetta Lab 05 - Authentication and Authorization (RBAC)
info.description: Comprehensive Automated Postman Test Suite for Lab 05 covering User Registration, Input Validation, Duplicate Email Check, Bcrypt Password Hashing, JWT Login, Authentication Middleware, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

item.name: 01. User Registration (Valid Input)

exec: const randomId = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100000);
pm.environment.set('testUserEmail', 'student_' + randomId + '@rosetta.local');
pm.environment.set('testUsername', 'student_' + randomId);
pm.test('01.1 - Status code is 201 Created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('01.2 - Returns JWT token', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

pm.test('01.3 - User object contains role User and email', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.user.role).to.eql('User'); pm.expect(d.user.email).to.eql(pm.environment.get('testUserEmail')); });
pm.test('01.4 - Password is not leaked in response', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.user.password).to.be.undefined; pm.expect(d.password).to.be.undefined; });

item.name: 02. Check Duplicate Email Registration

exec: pm.test('02.1 - Status code is 409 Conflict', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });
pm.test('02.2 - Error indicates duplicate email', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.error).to.include('already registered'); });

exec: pm.test('03.1 - Status code is 400 Bad Request', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('03.2 - Error indicates invalid email format', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.error).to.include('Invalid email format'); });

item.name: 06. User Login (Verify Email & Password -> Extract Token)

exec: pm.test('06.1 - Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('06.2 - Returns valid JWT token', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.environment.set('userToken', d.token); });

pm.test('06.3 - User object is sanitized', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.user.email).to.eql(pm.environment.get('testUserEmail')); pm.expect(d.user.password).to.be.undefined; });
